subject: cult-info-dy
title: CULT.INFO.DY.------MT.INFO.
description: Diagram in WAM-21, embedded in Braxton's argument that western art music has 'established a projection that corresponds to the dynamics of the composer rather than the total group' through the institutionalization of notation. CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics) is *crossed* — (c) prefix, the concept of — with MT-INFO (multi-information): the question is what happens to multi-information when culture's information dynamics have been re-shaped by composer-centric notation. The diagram routes the crossing: besides the main line to MT-INFO, CULT-INFO-DY branches into (c)POST (postulation), which carries CN-INFO (controlled information) and AFI (affinity insight) → PR-TRS, and into T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) → (r)TM (terminology—or terms of a definition).
